audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows disagreed with the packet chart and with the page's own whys: win[1] said K'Sante while whys[1] ends 'even skirmish'; win[3] said Skill while whys[3] says 'bank leads here'; win[5] said K'Sante while whys[5] says his drain starts matching your damage; win[6] said K'Sante while whys[6] says he out-heals you and you should not duel him.
audit.why: Sylas is squishy through the levels where K'Sante has W and E up, and reclaims the game on AP bruiser scaling and Kingslayer sustain.
audit.corrected: Level 2 = Skill, Levels 4-5 = K'Sante, First item = Skill, 2+ items = Sylas (4/10), all in matched pairs.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike gave no number for Hijack.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30 seconds — it comes back far faster than your 120/100/80 R, which is why 'hold your ult until he has spent his' is real advice and not just caution.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (a) 'W through his stun unstoppable' — Path Maker's Riot text says only 'taking reduced damage'; unstoppable is not stated anywhere in the kit. (b) His E was described as a 'chain stun' three times, but Riot's text for Abscond/Abduct is 'dashes to a location... recast to throw his chains out, pulling himself to an enemy he hits' — a pull, with no CC in the text and no hardCC flag on the ability.
audit.why: Both claims drive the same advice — 'charge W and ignore his lockdown' — and neither is supported by the file. The verifiable read is that Abscond is his only escape (13s at rank 1), so the punish is committing the moment he spends it.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around Abscond being spent and its 13s cooldown; the stun and the unstoppable are both gone.
sources: kit file: sylas E text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Kingslayer's healing was described only as 'Q-W drain' and Grievous Wounds was never called for in the content layer.
audit.why: Kingslayer heals him against champions and drops to a 6s cooldown at rank 5, so anti-heal timing decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into whys[6], spikes[3] and late, with Kingslayer named.
sources: kit file: sylas W heal flag, cd 12/10.5/9/7.5/6

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo lands: W through his stun unstoppable, then Q3 knocks up an immobile Sylas who already burned his E.
edits.after: Your full Q-W combo lands: W the moment he commits Abscond, then Q3-pull a Sylas who has already spent his only dash.

edits.before: His AP bruiser scaling and Q-W sustain out-heal your tank damage — peel with R, don't duel him late.
edits.after: Kingslayer's healing beats your tank damage without Grievous Wounds — peel with R, don't duel him late.

edits.before: Your full Q-W combo comes online — W a committed Sylas mid-E-dash and Q3 knock-up before his Q-W drain heals it back.
edits.after: Your full Q-W combo comes online — W him the moment Abscond commits, then Q3-pull before Kingslayer heals the trade back.

edits.before: Lane-control peak: trade around his E (chain stun) cooldown with your bulk and bank small leads while he is squishy.
edits.after: Lane-control peak: trade on his Abscond cooldown (13s at rank 1) with your bulk and bank leads while he is squishy.

edits.before: Danger window — Sylas R steals YOUR All Out, gaining your duelist shred against you, so don't ult into him when his R is up.
edits.after: Danger window — Hijack steals YOUR All Out and comes back in 80s at rank 1, so hold your ultimate until you have watched him spend his.

edits.before: Sylas hits his AP bruiser scaling and his sustained Q-W drain out-heals your tank damage — close before this.
edits.after: Sylas hits his AP bruiser scaling and Kingslayer out-heals your tank damage — buy Grievous Wounds or close before this.

edits.before: Sylas wants to E-dash in, chain-stun you and drain with Q-W to heal off the trade — but at Levels 1-2 he is squishy and his only safety is that E. Farm with Q range and don't trade into his full mana. Once you hit Level 3 you flip it: W-charge into his commitment so you tank his stun unstoppable, then Q3 to knock up and pull an immobile Sylas who has already used his dash.
edits.after: Sylas wants to Abscond in, chain to you with the Abduct recast and drain with Q-W to heal off the trade — but at Levels 1-2 he is squishy and that dash is his only safety. Farm with Q range and don't trade into his full mana. Once you hit Level 3 you flip it: W him the instant he commits the dash, then Q3 to pull an immobile Sylas who has already spent his escape.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are yours — your bulk eats his AP poke and you out-trade him around his E and Q-W cooldowns, banking small leads before he can scale. At 6 respect his R: it STEALS your All Out, so if you ult into him he gains your own duelist shred and burst back. Force trades when his E is down, but keep your ultimate in your pocket until his R has been spent.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are yours — your bulk eats his AP poke and you out-trade him around Abscond (13s) and Kingslayer, banking small leads before he can scale. At 6 respect his R: Hijack STEALS your All Out, so if you ult into him he gains your own duelist shred and burst back. Force trades when his E is down, but keep your ultimate pocketed until his R has been spent.

edits.before: This is where Sylas reclaims it. His Q-W drain out-sustains your tank damage and his AP bruiser items mean he heals through everything your armor stacking does nothing to stop. You are a teamfight peeler now, not a duelist — use R All Out to pull him off your carries rather than 1v1ing him, and lean on the side-lane lead you banked at 3-5 because the very late game belongs to his scaling.
edits.after: This is where Sylas reclaims it. Kingslayer out-sustains your tank damage and his AP bruiser items mean he heals through everything your armour stacking cannot stop, so Grievous Wounds is the only real answer. You are a teamfight peeler now, not a duelist — launch him off your carries with R rather than 1v1ing him, and lean on the side-lane lead you banked at 3-5.

edits.before: Reach Level 3 and W-charge through his E chain-dash, then Q3 knock-up the immobile Sylas
edits.after: Reach Level 3 and W him as Abscond commits, then Q3-pull a Sylas with no dash left

edits.before: Land E-dash stun then Q-W drain to heal every trade back even against your bulk
edits.after: Chain to you with the Abduct recast, then Q-W to heal the whole trade back

notes: The packet flagged that no Sylas ability was ever named; Abscond/Abduct, Kingslayer and Hijack are named now. One judgement call: the page called his E a 'chain stun', but the kit file's Abscond/Abduct text describes only a dash and a self-pull and carries no hardCC flag, so I removed the stun rather than assert it — see questionsForUser.
